_note: A deploy in flight is the shell's `publishJob` state machine, not something a
click reaches from a cold editor, so the probe hands PublishTab the shape that
machine is in mid-run. The panel under test is the shipped one.
NOT joined, and why:
784:4287 (Button · disabled) — this board fills it flowbite/gray/200 #e5e7eb;
board 781:4526 fills the SAME control --color/bg-subtle #f3f4f6, and its label
ink-muted #6b7280 against this board's ink-placeholder #9ca3af. Two boards
disagreeing cannot re-settle a control, so the code keeps 781:4526's greys and
the target stays SKIPPED rather than being scored against a coin toss. The
publish-load-error recipe measures the same button against the board that is
internally consistent with the rest of the set.
784:4309 / 784:4310 (progress track + fill) — the board draws 4px on a 2px
radius; the panel uses chrome-ui's `Progress`, i.e. flowbite `sm`, which is 6px
and fully rounded. flowbite's Progress puts no anchor on either the track or
the bar, so neither can be addressed by testId at all, and re-theming a shared
re-export off one board is the move this arc's precedent forbids.
784:4311 / 784:4315 / 784:4320 (ENVIRONMENT header and its rows) — the board
gives each row its own 16px gutter; the panel delivers the same 16px from
`CONTENT`'s px-4 one level up, so the rows measure 0. Moving the inset onto the
rows is right, and it changes every section on boards 641:2652 / 784:4326 /
784:4403 too — those have no recipe yet, so it belongs to their walk.
